{"content":"### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced
  `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` onto every non-headless host when no explicit
  `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine itself is intact —
  the incident session ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits the
  `tool_stuck` flag and never cancels/retries/converts. That is why fa 1.0.580 sat 27
  minutes on a dead `git fetch`: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then heartbeats only, until the
  owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Evidence: heartbeats continuing past the
  threshold is the advisory-only signature (autonomous mode abandons the attempt within
  `cancelGrace`); the full autonomous arc is pinned by `test/agent/stuck_tool_test.dart`.
- Violated the ticket's invariant I1: `advisory` must be an explicit opt-out, never an
  implicit default for interactive sessions.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous
  default (`StuckToolConfig()`) in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit
  `agent.stuckTool:` config still wins, so `followUp: advisory` remains a deliberate
  opt-out. Config persistence is unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (failed before the fix, pass after):
  - `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` — "gh-1632 I1: the autonomous default applies in
    EVERY mode — advisory only via explicit config" (expected `autonomous`, got
    `advisory` on the pre-fix code).
  - `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` — "gh-1632 I1: the wired supervision is
    autonomous in EVERY mode by default" (same assertion through the wired `AgentCli`).
- Full suite: `dart test` — see CI run on this PR for the final tally; the four directly
  affected files (`test/agent/stuck_tool_test.dart`, `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart`,
  `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`) pass 243/243.

### Notes

- Behavioral change: default-config interactive (REPL/TUI) sessions now auto-cancel a
  call stuck past its threshold, retry it once, and convert the retry to a background job
  instead of flagging and waiting. Owners who want the old flag-only behavior set
  `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory` explicitly.
- No false-positive risk change: thresholds are untouched (300 s floor; `factor ×
  declared` for declared-timeout bash calls), so a declared-15-min `flutter test` running
  6 minutes is still not stuck (AC7).
- Adjacent gap observed, not changed here: the desktop-app wiring

  owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Evidence: heartbeats continuing past the
  threshold is the advisory-only signature (autonomous mode abandons the attempt within
  `cancelGrace`); the full autonomous arc is pinned by `test/agent/stuck_tool_test.dart`.
- Violated the ticket's invariant I1: `advisory` must be an explicit opt-out, never an
  implicit default for interactive sessions.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous
  default (`StuckToolConfig()`) in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit
  `agent.stuckTool:` config still wins, so `followUp: advisory` remains a deliberate
  opt-out. Config persistence is unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (failed before the fix, pass after):
  - `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` — "gh-1632 I1: the autonomous default applies in
    EVERY mode — advisory only via explicit config" (expected `autonomous`, got
    `advisory` on the pre-fix code).
  - `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` — "gh-1632 I1: the wired supervision is
    autonomous in EVERY mode by default" (same assertion through the wired `AgentCli`).
- Full suite: `dart test` — see CI run on this PR for the final tally; the four directly
  affected files (`test/agent/stuck_tool_test.dart`, `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart`,
  `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`) pass 243/243.

### Notes

- Behavioral change: default-config interactive (REPL/TUI) sessions now auto-cancel a
  call stuck past its threshold, retry it once, and convert the retry to a background job
  instead of flagging and waiting. Owners who want the old flag-only behavior set
  `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory` explicitly.
- No false-positive risk change: thresholds are untouched (300 s floor; `factor ×
  declared` for declared-timeout bash calls), so a declared-15-min `flutter test` running
  6 minutes is still not stuck (AC7).
- Adjacent gap observed, not changed here: the desktop-app wiring
  (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` → `AgentWiringSpec.stuckTool`) passes the raw parsed section, so
  an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all (not even advisory). It never emits
  `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.
- Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape (cancel grace + one retry with full
  threshold re-arm, one background conversion, then a session-visible escalation); the
  ticket's 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner's follow-up.

{"content":"### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced
  `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` onto every non-headless host when no explicit
  `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine itself is intact —
  the incident session ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits the
  `tool_stuck` flag and never cancels/retries/converts. That is why fa 1.0.580 sat 27
  minutes on a dead `git fetch`: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then heartbeats only, until the
  owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Evidence: heartbeats continuing past the
  threshold is the advisory-only signature (autonomous mode abandons the attempt within
  `cancelGrace`); the full autonomous arc is pinned by `test/agent/stuck_tool_test.dart`.
- Violated the ticket's invariant I1: `advisory` must be an explicit opt-out, never an
  implicit default for interactive sessions.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous
  default (`StuckToolConfig()`) in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit
  `agent.stuckTool:` config still wins, so `followUp: advisory` remains a deliberate
  opt-out. Config persistence is unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests (failed before the fix, pass after):
  - `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` — "gh-1632 I1: the autonomous default applies in
    EVERY mode — advisory only via explicit config" (expected `autonomous`, got
    `advisory` on the pre-fix code).
  - `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` — "gh-1632 I1: the wired supervision is
    autonomous in EVERY mode by default" (same assertion through the wired `AgentCli`).
- Full suite: `dart test` — see CI run on this PR for the final tally; the four directly
  affected files (`test/agent/stuck_tool_test.dart`, `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart`,
  `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`) pass 243/243.

### Notes

- Behavioral change: default-config interactive (REPL/TUI) sessions now auto-cancel a
  call stuck past its threshold, retry it once, and convert the retry to a background job
